papers.title: Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds
papers.status: Draft; finite norm, marked diagram coefficient and invariant normalization proved together
imports: The enhanced ribbon definition of the reduced Kashaev invariant; the matrix and normalization comparison are proved in the paper.

papers.title: Newton coefficients and positive sources for Conway tangles
papers.status: Draft; exact complete-meridian Newton calculus and positive complete source for the stated completed-root grammar
imports: Actual physical crossing and full Hermite derivative identification from Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds, Proposition 5.1; enhanced reduced normalization from Theorem 10.1.

The physical pair commutant, turn, trace, color expansions and completed-root positive-source maximum are proved in the paper. Whole signed fillings, moving-meridian identities and a metric-volume interpretation require separate inputs.

papers.title: Uniform spectral bounds for local Casimir sources
papers.status: Draft; uniform local upper bounds with protected zeros and both level parities
imports: Finite Fourier/Casimir identification from Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds, Proposition 4.1 and equations (4.4)–(4.5).

papers.title: Holomorphic asymptotics of central shared face coefficients
papers.status: Draft; nonzero holomorphic central coefficient and shared spectral gap through all sufficiently large integer levels, both parities
imports: Exact local Fourier/Casimir and marked coefficient identities from Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds, Proposition 4.1 and Theorem 9.1.
Uniform cofactor bounds and the absolutely normalized triangle action from Uniform spectral bounds for local Casimir sources, Sections 3–5.
A positive stationary radius vector is an explicit analytic hypothesis; the classical packing theorem supplies it for matched spheres.

papers.title: Oscillatory filling sums with independently long twists
papers.status: Draft; conditional whole-sum asymptotic from an explicit local expansion and shared global gap
imports: Exact midpoint Hermite identity from Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds, Section 3.
The theorem assumes a nonzero holomorphic source expansion and a strict shared spectral gap; their construction for a knot and the action-volume equality are separate application inputs.

papers.title: Circle patterns and primitive fillings of augmented links
papers.status: Draft; classical complete geometry, original primitive fillings and absolute action-volume equality
imports: Elementary holomorphic implicit function theorem, differential forms and Stokes, and the ideal-tetrahedron Lobachevsky volume formula.
No quantum asymptotic or whole-character-variety uniqueness is assumed.

papers.title: Positive octahedra and primitive fillings for trees of crossing circles
papers.status: Draft; classical marked all-circle tree completion under sqrt(d_v^2+n_v^2)>=630, with absolute metric volume and a heterogeneous-radius alternative
imports: Only the local peripheral-volume differential for an oriented positive ideal chain from Circle patterns and primitive fillings of augmented links, Section 7, equation (7.3).

The ordered cut, positive blocks, primitive winding, cone completion and same-chain absolute-volume comparison are proved here. The paper does not import a quantum asymptotic or the companion long-filling existence theorem; moving-meridian and nonparabolic longitude adapters remain separate.

papers.title: Shared face estimates and triangular gluing for planar link diagrams
papers.status: Draft; weak-balance and full sector criteria, protected triangular gluing and an explicit certified seed
imports: Exact marked source and finite filling norm from Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds, Proposition 4.1 and Theorems 9.1 and 10.1.
Uniform local sector bounds from Uniform spectral bounds for local Casimir sources, Theorem 1.1.

The central expansion and entire filling sum from the source-asymptotics and oscillatory-fillings companions, with the original primitive volume calibration from Circle patterns and primitive fillings of augmented links.

papers.title: Balanced circle packings from terminal tangle decorations
papers.status: Draft; literal even terminal decoration enforces strict complete balance and gives the stated long-filling volume corollary for the resulting fixed knots
imports: Complete packing and original primitive markings from Circle patterns and primitive fillings of augmented links, Proposition 2.1 and Section 2.

Actual shared source, full-Hermite filling norm and reduced-invariant normalization from Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds; all-phase and all-real-spectrum local envelopes from Uniform spectral bounds for local Casimir sources, Theorem 1.1.

The unabridged finite-certificate criterion from Shared face estimates and triangular gluing for planar link diagrams; the actual central expansion and whole filling sum from source-asymptotics and oscillatory-fillings; primitive completion and absolute volume from marked-fillings.
The decoration and original pairing are fixed before the level. All old and new powers must be independently sufficiently long; the knot type can change.

papers.title: Triangular insertion and volume limits for augmented diagrams
papers.status: Draft; fixed-boundary disk action, insertion at ordinary faces and explicit thin-core families
imports: The definition of a certificate covering every locally allowed sector string, and its full-invariant volume consequence, from Shared face estimates and triangular gluing for planar link diagrams.
Complete marked circle geometry, local spectral envelopes, exact finite filling norms and central asymptotics from the five foundational companions.
The committed seventeen-region rational certificates for the explicit infinite sequence; the fixed-boundary and all-length arguments are proved in the paper.

papers.title: Volume limits for long alternating-generator three-braids

imports: Exact source identity, invariant normalization and uniform Hermite filling norm from Finite spectral evaluation and uniform filling bounds.
Uniform local sector estimates from Uniform spectral bounds for local Casimir sources, Theorem 1.1.

Actual central expansion and shared spectral gap from Holomorphic asymptotics of central shared face coefficients, Theorem 1.1; entire-sum evaluation from Oscillatory filling sums with independently long twists, Theorem 1.1.
